body.x: LAS VEGAS, USA (AVING Special Report on 'CES 2010') -- <Visual News> Asus showcased its high-performance gaming laptop 'ROG G73Jh' inspired by stealth aircraft at CES.

At the heart of the G73Jh lies the latest Intel Core i7 processor, DirectX 11 capable ATI Radeon HD5870 graphics, up to 8GB of DDR3 system memory, 8-channel HD audio with EAX 4.0 compatibility, on-the-fly overclocking, ambient lighting, and 1TB of storage space for incredible gaming and multitasking performance.
< AVING Las Vegas team is on-site bringing readers the latest product CES2010 from the show floor, covering the press conferences >
